title: calathea lageriana
intro: Calathea lageriana, commonly known as the Pin Stripe Calathea or the Purple Rose Calathea, is a species of flowering plant in the Marantaceae family. This plant is known for its striking foliage with vibrant colors and patterns, providing an ornamental value to indoor spaces. The health benefits of Calathea lageriana include its potential to reduce inflammation and stress, while its therapeutic actions include its use in traditional medicine for treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant, although not extensively studied, are believed to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
